page.layout: One page of text, one column, with running head at top right of centre and page number at top right. Two headings and two prayer paragraphs in the main column. Signature "K 2" at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: in civitatibus: & altera; qua extra civitates utuntur, Oppidani loquuntur ferè lingua Hispanica, Tarraconensi seu Catalana, quam didicerunt ab Hispanis; qui plerunque magistratum in ijsdem [?] gerunt civitatibus: alii verò genuinam retinent Sardorum linguam
main_text.head: Oratio Dominica in Sardorum oppidanorum lingua.
main_text.p: Pare nostre,che ses en lof cels: Sia sanct si eat lo nom teu: Venga lo regne teu: Fafase la voluntatua, axicom en lo cel, i en la terra. Lo pa nostre cotida dona a nos altres hui: i dexia a nosaltres los deutes nostres, axicom i nos altres dexiam als deutois nostres. Ino nos induescas en la tentatio: mas liura nos del mal.Perche teu es lo regne, la gloria, i lo imperii, en los figles de le sigles. A-men.
main_text.head: Eadem in Sardorum communiori linguâ, extra civitates.
main_text.p: Babu nostru sughale ses in soschelus: Santusiada su nomine tuo: Bengiad su rennu tuo: Faciadsi la voluntade tua, comenti in chelo & in sa terra. Sa pane nostrū dogniedie [?] dona a nos ateros hoæ:et [?] lassa a nos ateros is

page.notes: Printed text is clear apart from the marked words. "ijsdem" is printed with a damaged i/j and long s; reading uncertain. "dogniedie" is partly blurred at the line end. "hoæ:et" is hard to read at the line end. Line-end damage is also visible in "ateros is". Spelling in the Sardinian prayer follows the print (e.g. "voluntatua", "deutois", "induescas"). Long s replaced by plain s throughout.
